content.text:
I fitted the three bands with the full d⁶ Hamiltonian instead of Tanabe–Sugano matrices. I diagonalised all d⁶ Slater determinants with the Racah parameters B and C and an octahedral crystal field (t₂g at −4Dq, e_g at +6Dq). I kept only the singlet states and fixed C = 4.5B.

I then fitted Dq and B so that the three lowest spin-allowed levels above the ¹A₁g ground state match the observed maxima. These are ¹A₁g → ¹T₁g, ¹T₂g, and the next singlet level, which is ¹E_g here:

| Band | Observed (cm⁻¹) | Fitted (cm⁻¹) |
|---|---|---|
| ¹A₁g → ¹T₁g | 13 960 | 13 957 |
| ¹A₁g → ¹T₂g | 22 740 | 22 739 |
| third band (¹E_g) | 29 700 | 29 702 |

The fit gives Dq ≈ 1593 cm⁻¹ (10Dq ≈ 15 930 cm⁻¹), B ≈ 778 cm⁻¹ and C = 4.5B ≈ 3500 cm⁻¹. The residuals are all below 3 cm⁻¹.

As a consistency check, I compared the lowest singlet with the lowest quintet at these parameters. The ¹A₁g state lies about 2400 cm⁻¹ below the ⁵T₂g state, so the complex is low-spin as stated.

B ≈ 778 cm⁻¹ is large, so the fitted Dq/B ≈ 2.05 is close to the spin-crossover region.
